title: Opening and Wynn's name and birth date
summary: Wynn gives his name and spelling and says he was born in New Orleans on July 29, 1907.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Okay, it's going. You can give your name first.
My name is Albert Leroy Winn.
Oh, wait, let's try that again. The thing was slipping over. Try it once more.

Albert Leroy Winn. When were you born? I was born July the 29th, 1907, in New Orleans, Louisiana. And I might clarify it. In later years, some of the fellows called me Al. They sort of tagged the nickname on me, Al. They shortened it up a bit. But all the people that have known me for years, I'm still Albert.
Your last name, that's got the spelling too, because I've seen the E put on the end of it.
No, there's no E on it. W-Y-N-N.
